searchLog: Blocked before hunting could start: WebFetch returned EGRESS_BLOCKED for every external domain tried (job-boards.greenhouse.io, jobs.ashbyhq.com, api.ashbyhq.com, boards-api.greenhouse.io, anthropic.com, databricks.com, metacareers.com, notion.com, google.com, even en.wikipedia.org and news.ycombinator.com as control checks) — only github.com resolved. WebSearch still works and surfaced candidates (e.g. Anthropic Fellows cohort 3 applications reopening ~Sept 2026 for an Aug 2027 start; Scale AI's new-grad Strategic Projects Lead program; Sierra's APX rotational program), but hunt.md's verification bar requires confirming eligibility, open status, and cost from the actual page, not a search snippet — with WebFetch unavailable, none of these could be verified to that standard. Zero opportunities written rather than padding with unverified leads. This is a tooling/network-policy failure, not an empty market — see report.
